method: Size from the reaction base rate and realised vol, not from narrative. Direction only where run-up and reaction history disagree with what is plausibly priced: fade extended run-ups, tilt up where nothing is priced and the beat-rate is durable. Legible bull stories get discounted. Default Neutral when run-up is flat and prior signs are balanced.
key_drivers: No run-up to unwind: -2.8% 5d, -0.7% 20d, so little priced in either way
Positive Earnings ESP (+3.05%) and +7.2% average trailing four-quarter surprise
Reaction history sign-balanced (3 up, 4 down, 1 flat) - weak directional prior
Fat tails in the history (+27.5%, -9.3%) argue for a move far above the 1.89% median
Consensus calls for only modest top- and bottom-line growth; bar is low
what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence of a consumer/tariff-driven guidance cut or a pre-print re-rate that already discounts the beat.
reasoning: Base rate first: eight reactions split 3/4/1 with a 1.89% median but tails at +27.5 and -9.3, and 28% realised vol, so I size the move near 5% rather than the median. Direction is thin. The only genuine tilt is that nothing is priced - the stock drifted sideways for a month and sits 6.8% off its high - while WSM carries a durable positive surprise record and a positive ESP into a low consensus bar. That is a small, honest edge, not a strong one. Certainty stays Low because the same history contains a -9% print off a similar setup.

key_drivers: +10.5% 20d run-up into the print, 2.5% off the 52-week high - the good news is in the price
Bull case is maximally legible: beat-and-raise, 17 buys / zero sells, retail-facing 'catalyst' pieces
Spot $155 versus a $160 average target leaves almost no analyst headroom
Reaction history is unusually tame: median 1.18%, max 5.28% over eight prints
what_would_change_my_mind: A guidance raise large enough to move the FY range materially, which this name's 1.2% median reaction says is rare.
reasoning: This is the case my method was written to catch. The story is strong and completely public - raised guide, expanding margin, nine quarters of book-to-bill above one - and the stock has already added roughly 10% in twenty sessions to sit near its high with the sell side at zero sells. A widely-known good story is not an edge. Against that, the sign history is 6 up of 8, which offsets the fade instinct rather than reversing it. Net: no directional call. Size stays modest but above the 1.18% median because the run-up raises the downside if the raise is merely in line; 2.8% is my centre.

key_drivers: +49.5% in 20 sessions, +9.7% in 5, printing at the exact 52-week high - maximal expectations
Six of the last eight reactions negative despite a run of beats: this name sells the news
RSI into the 70s and momentum-screen coverage flag late-stage crowding, not fresh accumulation
71.5% realised vol plus tails at +22.5% and -18.1% imply a double-digit move
Management already trimming forward ARR growth (32%) versus subscription guide (41%)
what_would_change_my_mind: A large ARR guidance raise with margin expansion ahead of the 14% FY27 target, which the December 2025 +22% print shows this stock can pay for.
reasoning: The strongest signal here is the mismatch between run-up and reaction history. Rubrik has beaten and turned surprise profits for three straight quarters and the stock still fell on six of its last eight prints - the bar reprices faster than the results. Now it arrives at the print having added half its value in a month, at the top tick of its range, on a rotation into cybersecurity that momentum screens are already advertising. That is the setup my method fades. I hold the tilt modest, not strong, because the one exception (December 2025, +22.5%) shows a genuine ARR acceleration can override the pattern. Size is set from 71.5% vol and the fat tails: roughly 10-11%, either way.
